Aisha: FYI running eval harness on v0.9-quant produced nondet outputs for top_p sampling even when passing seed=42. Repro steps below, failing on a handful of prompts :/

Tom: Uh that's weird. Are the requests identical (same prompt, same model binary, same batch size)?

Aisha: Yes — same quantized build, same model shard, same batch size=8. We noticed divergence only when microbatching + tokenization happens in parallel across workers. Single-worker runs are stable.

Riley: That smells like sampling order / RNG handoff. If two workers apply top_p across different token subsets and recombine, order of operations can affect floating point decisions. top_p isn't associative.

Jun: Can you paste a short log snippet where the mismatch shows? Also, do you log sampling params with the response? Without explicit top_p/seed/temperature in telemetry it's hard to repro.

Aisha: Paste from failing CI run. checksum is md5 of joined strings for quick diff.

Aisha: ```
run_id=ci-2026-03-12-42
prompt_id=kb_117
seed=42
model=redwood-ggml-q4_0
batch_size=8
microbatch_size=2
top_p=0.92
temperature=0.0
output_checksum_workerA=9f1c3b2a
output_checksum_workerB=9f1c3b2f
```

Tom: Checksums differing by a few chars — consistent with small sampling divergences. If temperature was 0.0 and we're using top_p, that's already a hybrid: deterministic tokens when temp=0 usually pairs with top_k/argmax; top_p introduces nondet even at temp=0 depending on implementation.

Riley: Exactly. Also quant kernels may reorder probabilities slightly due to vectorized reductions. Any tiny eps change can flip the top_p cutoff. Combined with interleaved microbatch scheduling it becomes nondet.

Jun: Short-term mitigation: enforce deterministic sampling path when a seed is provided and temperature==0.0 — treat top_p like top_k with argmax fallback. Longer-term: make sampling selection algorithm tolerant to tiny fp perturbations by using stable sort + tie-breaker by token id. Also, make RNG per-request seeded from a single source: hash(request_id || global_seed || worker_id).

Aisha: Proposed patch sketch (Python-like):
Aisha: ```
def make_request_rng(request_id, global_seed, worker_id):
    seed_bytes = f"{request_id}:{global_seed}:{worker_id}".encode()
    return random.Random(int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(seed_bytes).digest()[:8], "big"))

# sampling loop uses rng.choice with stable sorting on probs + token_id as tie-breaker
```

Tom: Can you also add explicit logging of sampling params and microbatch ordering to the payload returned by the eval runner? Having these in the CI artifact would make diffs cheap.

Aisha: Yup — plan: tag outputs with sampling_meta = {"seed":42, "rng_kind":"per_request", "microbatch_order": [0,1,2,3], "kernel_build":"q4_0-v1"}. Will update the harness.

Riley: For the CI gate: add a smoketest that runs the same prompt 10x in parallel on the same commit; require checksums to be identical across runs when seed provided and temp==0 (or when we decide deterministic-mode is enabled). Otherwise fail and surface sampling_meta.

Jun: Also add a unit that simulates tiny fp perturbations to check stability boundary. We can fuzz probs by +/- 1e-6 and assert stable decisions when in deterministic-mode.

Aisha: I'll open a PR with the rng change + telemetry + CI job. Will tag y'all for review.

ci-bot: CI run queued for branch aisha/fix-deterministic-sampling (job id: 7812).

Tom: Nice. Thanks — if this lands we should add a short doc in eng-ml about "deterministic sampling modes" so model-onboarding folks know what to expect. :memo:

Riley: Agreed. Also call out quantization caveat: small fp perturbations are expected; rely on deterministic-mode for eval comparisons. :eyes:

Jun: One more note — make sure we persist the seed used in logs even when it's generated server-side (e.g., no-seed path). Otherwise artifacts won't be reproducible.

Aisha: Good call. I'll include both requested_seed and effective_seed in sampling_meta. Will follow up with PR link shortly.

Aisha: (cc @Riley @Jun @Tom) planning to run a 50x parallel smoke locally first, will post results.
